walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What case does 'helfen' (to help) require for its object?
options: Dative - 'Ich helfe DIR' (I help you).
Nominative.
Accusative - 'Ich helfe DICH'.
First position.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I like school because the teachers are nice' in German?
options: Ich mag die Schule, weil die Lehrer nett sind.
Ich mag die Schule, weil sind die Lehrer nett.
Ich mag die Schule, weil die Lehrer sind nett.
Nominative.

mcqs.q: Where does the verb go after 'weil' (because)?
options: First position.
Second position, as in main clauses.
Ich mag die Schule, weil sind die Lehrer nett.
At the end of the clause.
